name: ua-vehicle-registry-data
title: UA Vehicle Registry — Data Quality Edition
description: A normalized derivative of the Ukrainian open dataset 'Відомості про транспортні засоби та їх власників' (MIA, data.gov.ua), designed for reproducible analytical use. Schema 3.0: every snapshot 2013–2026 is built from one source revision per period (docs/SOURCES.md), one row per distinct source row. Columns the source does not have for a period are omitted from that file.

sources.title: Відомості про транспортні засоби та їх власників

resources.name: snapshot
resources.description: Release assets: mvs_opendata_YYYY_MM.{parquet,csv} (tag vYYYY.MM) and mvs_opendata_YYYY.{parquet,csv} (tag vYYYY.full).

fields.name: record_id
fields.description: MD5 of the source fields of the row (operation name excluded: the source spells one operation in several ways). Unique across the dataset.

fields.name: person_type
fields.description: Type of owner. P = natural person (фізична особа), J = legal entity (юридична особа).

fields.name: reg_addr_koatuu
fields.description: KOATUU code of the owner's registered address, as a string to keep leading zeros. Not in the source from 2026-04-30.

fields.name: oper_code
fields.description: Numeric code of the registration operation. Identifies the operation; use it rather than oper_name for grouping.

fields.name: oper_name
fields.description: Operation name as in the source, with Latin I inside Cyrillic words replaced by Cyrillic І. The source uses more than one wording for some codes.

fields.name: d_reg
fields.description: Date of the registration operation. Parquet type DATE; CSV text YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: dep_code
fields.description: Service center code, as a string. From 2026-04-30 recovered from the service center name; null where no match exists.

fields.name: dep_name
fields.description: Name of the service center.

fields.name: brand
fields.description: Brand in Latin script. Brands present in the reference catalogue get the catalogue spelling (Volkswagen, Mercedes-Benz) regardless of the model; others keep the source spelling.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Model in Latin script, mapped to a catalogue model family where one exists (MEGANE SCENIC → Scenic); otherwise the source model.

fields.name: vin
fields.description: Normalized VIN: upper case, separators removed, Cyrillic look-alike letters replaced by Latin (А→A, В→B, З→3 …). Other Cyrillic letters are kept. Matches the 17-character VIN pattern only where is_valid_vin is true. The source has VINs from 2021.

fields.name: make_year
fields.description: Year of manufacture as in the source. 1900 is a source placeholder for an unknown year.

fields.name: color
fields.description: Body color. The 2025+ source spelling 'ПОМАРАНЧЕВИЙ (ОРАНЖЕВИЙ)' is published as 'Оранжевий', as in 2013–2024.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: Vehicle kind (e.g. Легковий, Вантажний, Автобус).

fields.name: body
fields.description: Body type group (e.g. Седан, Хетчбек, Сідловий Тягач); null where the source value is empty or unknown to the mapping.

fields.name: purpose
fields.description: Vehicle purpose (e.g. Загальний, Спеціалізований).

fields.name: fuel
fields.description: Primary fuel (Бензин, Дизель, Газ, Електро, Водень). For hybrids the combustion fuel; the electric part is in secondary_fuel.

fields.name: capacity
fields.description: Engine displacement in cm³ exactly as in the source, including electric vehicles (where the source often has an empty value or battery capacity).

fields.name: power_kwt
fields.description: Engine power in kW with the source precision (154.6). Published by the source from 2026-04-30; carried to other registrations of the same VIN found in the source (2021 onward).

fields.name: own_weight
fields.description: Curb weight in kg as in the source.

fields.name: total_weight
fields.description: Gross weight in kg as in the source.

fields.name: n_reg_new
fields.description: Registration plate, up to 2026-04-29; not in the source from 2026-04-30.

fields.name: payload
fields.description: total_weight − own_weight; null where own_weight exceeds total_weight (a source error).

fields.name: secondary_fuel
fields.description: Secondary fuel (Газ for LPG/CNG, Електро for hybrids).

fields.name: n_reg_latin
fields.description: n_reg_new transliterated to Latin. Same periods as n_reg_new.

fields.name: is_valid_plate
fields.description: Whether the plate matches one of the standard civilian formats: AA0000AA (2004+), 00000AA (1995–2004), online-registration codes. Other formats (e.g. 16ВР3029, diplomatic) give false. Same periods as n_reg_new.

fields.name: raw_vin
fields.description: VIN exactly as in the source. From 2021.

fields.name: is_valid_vin
fields.description: True when vin is 17 characters from the VIN alphabet (no I, O, Q) and does not start with 0. Format check only: the check digit is not verified, because most non-North-American VINs do not use one. From 2021.
